title: Build a white-label usage and limits dashboard
description: Run a credential-free sample dashboard, then progressively connect experimental usage, limits, people, departments, and spend-client APIs without disguising missing capabilities.
timeEstimate: ~15 min for the sample; live setup depends on API rollout
prerequisites: No Glean credentials are needed for the fictional sample
Live mode additionally needs an authorized experimental-API workspace, a complete HTTPS backend origin, and billing-read permissions; writes require billing-edit permissions

demoQueries.query: Review usage trends and observed models
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: Shows explicitly fictional sample consumption with separate USD and credit totals. Missing observations and unknown source metadata never become verified zero or billing truth.

demoQueries.query: Open a person and review a monthly limit
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: Shows configured-budget evaluation, previews the exact natural-key policy, and applies it only to in-memory sample data unless live writes were explicitly enabled.

demoQueries.query: Explore reporting lines and replay an API query
demoQueries.expectedBehavior: Shows directory manager relationships without implying IdP-group membership. Read-only replay preserves the original query and page size when following opaque cursors.

codeAssets.description: Self-contained Node and browser sample with a server-side experimental REST bridge and contract-focused tests

steps.title: Verify the sample and transport contracts
steps.description: Runs credential-free fixture tests. This does not claim live API verification.

steps.title: Start the sample dashboard
steps.description: Open the Local URL printed by the server (it chooses an available port). All people, models, clients, and consumption are fictional. Follow the README separately to connect a real workspace.

run.url: the Local URL printed by the server

aiPrompt: Copy and run the usage-admin-dashboard scaffold exactly. Install with npm ci, run npm run verify:fixture, and start npm start. Explain that the default mode uses fictional sample data only. Keep the recipe in preview until real end-to-end workspace verification. For optional live mode, read its README, keep credentials in the local server, use the pinned @gleanwork/auth package for login, and opt in to experimental APIs. Do not send any policy write without explicit user authorization. Never synthesize a department, group, model, or org-subtree limit from the supported organization/user contract.
llmContext: Progressively live preview test bed. Usage search reports observed stored rows, not certified history, live counters, or verified zero. Never combine USD and CREDITS. Evaluation is configured-budget status, not runtime admission. P0 supports ORGANIZATION, DEFAULT_USER, USER, and aggregate-agent limits; edit only organization/default-user/user policies via the public JSON-array batch. Department/group management and org-node membership mapping are missing. Models filter reporting only. Use ai_gateway.usage_client_id verbatim, never OAuth client_id or constructed prefixes. Manager links form a read-only forest, not IdP membership. Live unavailability never falls back to fixtures. Read-only replay preserves query fields, page size, and opaque snapshot cursors. The REST bridge is temporary until these experimental contracts reach the released SDK.

content.problem: Administrators need a customer-branded view of usage and policy that remains useful while experimental APIs roll out independently. This recipe starts with a demonstrable sample and promotes each real API surface without turning unavailable data into empty charts or inventing policy targets.
takeItFurther: Replace the temporary REST bridge with a pinned released SDK once it includes these operations.
Add deployment-specific session authentication and per-admin authorization before hosting this local-only recipe.
Enable department or group reporting and policy management only after their contracts are supported and identity mapping is explicit.

limitations.title: Preview, not live-verified
limitations.description: The shipped fixture tests validate the recipe and observed API contract shapes. No live tenant credentials, production policy writes, or deployed API availability have been verified.

limitations.title: Local single-admin test bed
limitations.description: The server binds to loopback and uses one operator’s credentials. Do not expose it publicly or treat it as a multi-user admin service.

limitations.title: Not every north-star policy exists yet
limitations.description: Department, group, org-subtree, and model policy writes are gated. Model breakdown choices come only from observed results, not a workspace-wide supported-model catalog.
